result.summary: I fixed the root cause of FIX-ZS1-B1 in one game file, scripts/race3d/layers/far_ground.gd. The far-ground plane now sits at the lower of two heights: 4 m under the lowest road of the loaded window, or 0.3 m under the lowest water surface there. The water surface is taken row by row on every bridge in the window, at the height the terrain draws it (road height + water_level). Without deep water the plane is exactly where it was (unit test, within 1e-5 m). It only ever moves down, so F7 still holds. It still glides at the old slope (FOLLOW_SLOPE); at the Köhlbrandbrücke it drops 5 m over 14 m of driving, about 1.1 km before the bridge (inferred from the code). A data scan of all 128 stage directions found 7 bridges in 15 directions with the water hidden: Köhlbrandbrücke, Holtenauer Hochbrücke, Kirchenfeldbrücke, and the 5 m cable-stayed bridges in Köln, Budapest, Belgrade and Riga. With the fix the plane lies under the water at all 122 bridge directions (measured). The new unit test is green 4/4 and red 3/4 on 3a23cb8. I looked at every picture, including before/after triptychs. The Elbe and the floating ferries now show by day and night, on Hoch and on the Steam Deck preset. Holtenau, the Rhine and the Danube are also fixed. The Elbbrücken pictures are bit-identical before and after. The lower plane shows only as a strip of at most 12 rows at the horizon; no pit. In modern-make only modern_s4_mittel changed (393 horizon pixels). All gates are green on 0ad9012. Test build 0.8.0-zs1 was built from 0ad9012 and delivered. Smoke tests passed on Linux (OpenGL and OpenGL ES) and on Windows under Wine. The Elbe is visible in both exported builds. I removed the meadow sentence from was_neu.md.

contract_issues: D16 and A-3 define the far-ground plane as 'lowest road of the loaded window - 4 m'. I implemented the lower of that height and 'lowest water of the window - 0.3 m'; D16/A-3 should be amended the same way (FIX-ZS1 raised this as its contract issue 3).

result.look_verdict: At the Köhlbrandbrücke Modern was clearly worse than Arcade: meadow to the horizon instead of the Elbe, with the ferries standing on grass. Now the Elbe has Arcade's extent under and beside the bridge and the ferries float. Together with the real 3D bridge (pylons, cable fans, railings, shadows), Modern is equal to slightly better than Arcade by day, but not clearly better. Behind the river a strip of meadow replaces Arcade's grey quay wall, because there is no far water. The water is a flat, sky-tinted surface without waves or glints; Arcade's is equally flat but a more saturated blue. At night the water is right, but the pylons glow almost white. The Steam Deck preset looks the same, with a slightly wider meadow strip at the horizon. Holtenau, the Rhine in Köln and the Danube in Budapest went from clearly worse (brown or grey ground instead of the river) to equal. The Elbbrücken and Venice were already equal and are unchanged.

result.verdict: Yes, the build can go to the user. I found nothing that blocks it and no fault in the water fix itself. In both shipped programs the Elbe now shows under and beside the Köhlbrandbrücke and the ferries float on it: by day and at night, on Hoch and on the Steam Deck preset. The Windows export under Wine gave pixel-identical frames to the Linux export. No pit, no seam and no holes: 0 magenta pixels below the horizon in the cover debug view, measured in 10 frames. The ground does not jump when the plane sinks at km 67.1: compared with the old far_ground.gd, only 5 horizon rows change, on at most 0.21 % of the pixels, gradually over 0.3 s. The build is exactly commit 0ad9012: a fresh export of the game data matches the shipped one in 1010 of 1011 files (only project.binary, the planned test-build settings), and against the previous ZS1 build only far_ground.gdc changed. The gates are green: Arcade 20 of 20 and 17 of 17 identical, terrain_cover OK, and the new unit test catches four deliberate breakages of the fix. Fairness is not affected: the plane can only lie lower than before, so it can never hide anything the player reacts to. Honest comparison: at the bridge Modern is now equal to slightly better than Arcade by day, not clearly better. At night it is worse because the pylons glow almost white. Separately, Modern has no landmark in six cities (B1, e.g. Belgrade and Hannover); this was already in the previous build. Four lines for was_neu.md and two corrections for the checklist are listed in bericht.md (B4); they can be edited without a rebuild.
